idea-plugin.name: Copilot Cost Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Copilot Cost Lens — AI Usage & Spend Tracker

Know exactly what your AI coding tools cost you — per repository, per model, per day. 100% local and private. Copilot Cost Lens reads the logs that GitHub Copilot (VS Code Chat and the Copilot CLI) and Claude Code already keep on your machine, attributes every request to the repository you were working in, prices it using the providers' model rates, and shows it all in a live dashboard tool window.

Features

  • Cost per repository — every request attributed to its repo via the git remote.
  • All your AI tools in one ledger — VS Code Copilot Chat, GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code, with a per-provider spend split.
  • Token anatomy & effective $/1M — input, output, cache read and cache write tokens per model, and the blended price actually paid.
  • Dashboard — spend, allowance gauge, end-of-month forecast and burn-rate, cost-by-repo and model charts, daily trend and an activity heatmap.
  • Project groups — roll several repositories into one project; combined receipt PDF with a per-repository breakdown.
  • Filter, sort, star — built for 100+ repositories.
  • Receipt PDF export — a classic printed-receipt per repository or project.
  • Budgets & credit alerts — set your plan allowance and absolute AI-credit thresholds.

Privacy: everything happens on your machine — no network requests, no telemetry.

Independent open-source project, not affiliated with GitHub or Microsoft.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 1.0.0 — Initial release: dashboard, per-repository cost tracking across Copilot Chat, Copilot CLI and Claude Code, project groups, receipts, budgets and the activity heatmap.
